359c88de-33d7-4a01-8760-8eaa293dff6c.title: Junior Project Coordinator / QA Tester
359c88de-33d7-4a01-8760-8eaa293dff6c.description:
About Us: Software development agency serving US/EU clients. We build web and mobile applications using React, Node.js, Python, Bubble.io, and AI tools.


The Role: Help manage client projects and ensure quality delivery. You'll coordinate between developers and clients, test applications, and keep projects on track.


Responsibilities:

Manual QA testing of web/mobile applications
Get daily updates from developers and format into client reports
Track project status in ClickUp
Schedule meetings and follow up on deliverables
Basic project coordination and communication


Requirements:

0-2 years experience (fresh grads welcome if organized and sharp)
Strong written English communication
Detail-oriented and organized
Basic understanding of web/mobile applications
Comfortable learning new tools (ClickUp, Slack, testing tools)
Full-time | On-site


Technical Skills (Bonus, not required):

Experience with project management tools
Manual testing experience
Basic understanding of software development


What We Offer:

PKR 40,000-60,000/month (based on experience)
Real client work from day one
Learn project management and QA
Work with international clients
Growth opportunities

233fefcf-8c06-4afa-a4d3-e282b87a6009.title: Full Stack Engineer
233fefcf-8c06-4afa-a4d3-e282b87a6009.description:
At Consolices, we build web and mobile applications for US/EU clients using React, Node.js, Python, Bubble.io, and AI tools. We work directly with founders and operators, turning messy ideas into shipped products.



You'll work on:

Full-stack development across React, Node.js, Python, Bubble.io
System architecture and database design from scratch
AI integrations (OpenAI, Claude, agentic workflows, RAG, automation)
API design and third-party integrations (Stripe, HubSpot, Twilio, etc.)
Direct client communication and requirement gathering


🎯 Who we're looking for:

What interests us more is the way you think and solve problems, not how many projects you've worked on.



You're a good fit if:

✅ 2+ years professional development experience (agency, startup, or strong freelance)

✅ You can read between the lines of client requirements and ask the right questions

✅ You design systems before writing code (databases, APIs, data flow, edge cases)

✅ You've worked with AI tools beyond just wrapping a ChatGPT call

✅ You communicate clearly in writing and on calls with clients, team, async

✅ You learn new tech fast and don't wait to be taught

✅ You take ownership end to end, not just the ticket assigned to you



Technical experience we expect:

Built and shipped production web apps with React, Node.js, or Python
Designed databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar) for real products
Built REST APIs and integrated third-party services
Worked with AI APIs (OpenAI, Claude, embeddings, agents, vector DBs)
Bonus: Bubble.io, mobile (React Native, Flutter), DevOps, n8n


What matters more than your stack:

You've shipped products people actually use. You can run a project without daily babysitting. You ask smart questions when stuck instead of guessing. You understand the business behind the product, not just the code.
